newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's RAI retains national soccer team rights.
newsitem.headline: Italy's RAI retains national soccer team rights.

text.p: The Italian soccer federation said on Tuesday that state broadcaster RAI would retain the rights to screen the Italian national soccer team's home matches in 1997.
It said in a statement that the deal was worth 48 billion lire ($31 million) to the federation.
The Mediaset group controlled by former prime minister Silvio Berlusconi said on Monday it would not bid for the matches because it could not justify the cost.
RAI's rights to the home games expired last December and Mediaset had until Monday to decide whether or not it would bid for the one-year contract.
The federation said it extended the contract until December 31 this year, but would hold a national auction for the next multi-year contract.
